author: WaveConquerer
body:
Hey everyone.  I'm looking for a map team (obv. by the title of this post).  I was wondering who would be interested in having me.  I have built five maps for avicus (actually, for the former MCZ), only one of which was ever accepted.  I'd enjoy helping others with their visions.  I can terraform, do some builds based upon the task, or whatever small stuff is needed.  I'd also want to take any opportunity granted to me as a chance to learn how to build better.

I can post some examples later (feeling lazy/about to eat dinner at the time of this post).  Thank you to whoever responds to this; and please give me constructive criticism so i can better myself.
